description:
Apply the naming decision from T4. If the decision was 'rename use_cell → use_observable':

1. The current `use_observable` is still alive at this point — first delete it (it has no callers after T7).
2. Then rename `use_cell` → `use_observable` (and `use_cell_subscribed` etc. internals).
3. Update example call sites and docstrings.

If the decision was 'keep use_cell as the public name', this task is just a docs/changelog update.

Do not touch the Subscriber/`%Filament.Observable.Subscriber{}` machinery here — that is T9.
title: Rename hook surface per Q2 decision
